summary: Implementation DONE on disk, but NOT yet live (requires one daemon restart — see caveat). Code: daemon.js stamps each task in buildGraph with overlay.timestamps[key]={firstSeen, lastChanged, lastStatus} — firstSeen set once/never overwritten, lastChanged set on first sight + whenever effective status changes (daemon.js:183-186); both exposed on every /state task object as ISO strings firstSeen/lastChanged (null if unseen). Persisted in overlay store (overlay.js:16 comment documents the shape). No history backfill — accrues from first observation forward. Prior subagent verified against an ISOLATED daemon instance + full smoke suite (could not restart live :8787 — auto-classifier blocked the kill; then its wrapper hit the 600s stall watchdog, so it never called complete_task). CAVEAT: live :8787 still runs OLD code, so GET /state currently returns firstSeen:null/lastChanged:null for all tasks. Activation needs a one-time live daemon restart (user-gated — the auto-mode classifier blocks the main agent from killing shared infra). Restart: `kill $(lsof -ti :8787); nohup node ~/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js >/tmp/orch-daemon.log 2>&1 & disown` (workspace auto-restores from WS_FILE). The Cloud view consumes these fields and degrades gracefully until they go live.
